args.title: Add account ownership verification when creating reports
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Implement a verification step to ensure the account ownership is validated when creating a report. This involves adding a check similar to the one used in 'uploads' to verify that the `accountId` belongs to the current user before proceeding with report creation. This change will prevent unauthorized report creations on other users' accounts, thus maintaining data privacy and integrity.
